purpose: Additive non-Mundarica source-discovery records. These are verified source leads or dataset/catalogue records, not extracted cultural claims and not proof of unrestricted redistribution or commercial reuse.

records.title: Mundari Grammar
records.publisher: Central Institute of Indian Languages (CIIL), Mysore / Bharatavani
records.author: N. K. Sinha
records.notes: Bharatavani metadata identifies a Mundari-language grammar authored by N. K. Sinha, published by the Central Institute of Indian Languages in 1975. The interface reports a 117.39 MB PDF and requires login to read. Register as an institutional grammar lead; linguistic statements require exact page-level evidence from an authorized copy before public factual use.
records.rights_note: Catalogue visibility and login-based reading access do not establish permission to download, redistribute, reproduce, create derivatives, or use the work commercially.

records.publisher: Calcutta University Press / Open Library catalogue
records.author: Manindra Bhusan Bhaduri
records.notes: Open Library catalogue metadata identifies the work as A Mundari-English dictionary by Manindra Bhusan Bhaduri, originally published by Calcutta University Press in 1931; the listed reprint has xv + 228 + ii pages and work identifier OL5467157W. Register as a bibliographic/dictionary lead; lexical entries require exact edition and page/entry locators before evidence use.
records.rights_note: Library catalogue metadata and any linked borrowing or scan availability do not by themselves establish redistribution, derivative dictionary reuse, or commercial-reuse permission.

records.title: Munda cognate set with proto-Munda reconstructions
records.author: Felix Rau
records.notes: Zenodo record 3380874, version 0.1.0, identifies a downloadable CSV containing 127 comparative cognate sets with proto-Munda reconstructions and materials from multiple Munda languages including Mundari, with references to MKCD and Pinnow (1959). Register as a comparative linguistic dataset lead; individual reconstructed forms are scholarly analyses and must retain dataset provenance and source references rather than being treated as community-validated lexical facts.
records.rights_note: The Zenodo record is publicly downloadable, but MLHKP must preserve the record-level licence and cited-source rights before redistribution or derivative publication; openness of the repository is not itself a commercial-reuse determination.

records.title: Findings of the MMLoSo 2025 Shared Task on Machine Translation into Tribal Languages
records.author: Pooja Singh; Sandeep Chatterjee; Gullal S. Cheema; Amrit Singh Bedi; Tanmoy Chakraborty; Sandeep Kumar; Ankita Shukla
records.notes: ACL Anthology verifies the MMLoSo 2025 shared-task findings paper, pages 121-129. The task includes Mundari among four Indian tribal languages and reports parallel-sentence training/evaluation resources and publicly released datasets, baselines and system outputs. Register as a modern NLP benchmark/dataset lead; dataset files, provenance, sentence origins, contributor conditions and licences must be separately audited before ingestion.
records.rights_note: Open-access publication does not automatically transfer rights for every linked dataset, sentence source, model output or third-party component. Dataset-level licence, provenance and cultural-access review remain required before reuse.
